info.name: 🚀 Learning NestJS API
info.description:
# 🚀 Learning NestJS API Collection

Comprehensive API documentation and test suite for the **Learning NestJS** backend with **PostgreSQL** and **TypeORM**.

---

### ⚙️ Variables
* `baseUrl`: `http://localhost:3000/api`

### 📂 Modules
1. **📦 Products:** Full CRUD connected to PostgreSQL via TypeORM.
2. **👥 Users:** User management endpoints.
3. **⭐ Reviews:** Product review endpoints.
4. **🌐 System:** App health & welcome endpoint.

item.name: 📦 Products
item.description: Endpoints for managing products stored in PostgreSQL database via TypeORM.

request.description:
### 📦 Get All Products
Fetches a list of all products from the PostgreSQL database along with matching reviews.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/products`
* **Success Response:** `200 OK`

### 🔍 Get Product By ID
Fetches a single product by its unique integer identifier.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/products/:id`
* **Throws:** `404 Not Found` if product does not exist.

### ✨ Create Product
Creates a new product record in PostgreSQL.

* **Method:** `POST`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/products`
* **Body Validation:**
  * `title`: String (3 - 30 chars, required)
  * `description`: String (5 - 500 chars, required)
  * `price`: Number (>= 0, required)

### ✏️ Update Product
Updates an existing product in the database.

* **Method:** `PUT`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/products/:id`
* **Body:** All fields are optional (`title`, `description`, `price`).

### 🗑️ Delete Product
Permanently removes a product from PostgreSQL.

* **Method:** `DELETE`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/products/:id`
* **Success Response:** `{"message": "Product deleted successfully"}`

### 👥 Get All Users
Retrieves a list of all registered users.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users`

### 👤 Get User By ID
Retrieves profile details for a specific user.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/:id`

### ✨ Create User
Registers a new user.

* **Method:** `POST`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users`
* **Body Validation:**
  * `name`: String (3 - 30 chars, required)
  * `email`: Valid email format (required)
  * `age`: Number (>= 1, optional)

### 🗑️ Delete User
Deletes a user account.

* **Method:** `DELETE`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/users/:id`

item.name: ⭐ Reviews
item.description: Endpoints for product ratings and feedback reviews.

request.description:
### ⭐ Get All Reviews
Fetches all customer reviews across the platform.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/reviews`

### 🔎 Get Review By ID
Fetches a specific review by ID.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/reviews/:id`

### ✍️ Create Review
Adds a new customer review.

* **Method:** `POST`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/reviews`
* **Body Validation:**
  * `text`: String (3 - 200 chars, required)
  * `rating`: Number (1 to 5, required)

### 📝 Update Review
Modifies review content or rating.

* **Method:** `PUT`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/reviews/:id`

### 🗑️ Delete Review
Removes a review from the system.

* **Method:** `DELETE`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}/reviews/:id`

item.name: 🌐 System
item.description: Root server health and welcome endpoints.

request.description:
### 👋 Root Welcome Endpoint
Basic health check endpoint returning welcome greeting.

* **Method:** `GET`
* **URL:** `{{baseUrl}}`
* **Response:** `🟢 Hello World! Welcome to the API.✈️💥🚀🔥`
